findings.description: Fresh banks select distractors from lexicographic neighborhoods centered on the key. Choosing the lexicographic median without inspecting the matrix has a reproducible advantage. When both side pools contain at least four candidates, its exact success probability is 3/8 instead of 1/5. This is statistical leakage, not a universal bypass.
findings.reproduction: Run shortcut_reproduction.py using the supplied Python executable, following commands.txt. Minimal actual-batch witness: generate('moderate', 431440325). The third lexicographically sorted choice is the accepted {a13,a22,a33}. shortcut-minimal-records.json retains the complete record; shortcut-construction-law.json records the two 12-candidate pools and exact probability. cue_probe.py and delivery_selection.py reproduce the distributional result.
findings.requested_change: Change fresh-bank construction so distractors are not drawn from a bounded lexicographic neighborhood centered on the key. Preserve source profiles and valid offered operations, then retest coordinate-order strategies through actual CLI resampling and delivery. Retain the matrix-blind probe as a regression.
